# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind, assume good faith, give and take feedback gracefully, and
focus on what's best for the project. Harassment, personal attacks and
publishing others' private information are not tolerated, whoever (or
whatever agent) does it.

The same standard applies to AI agents in the fleet: an agent's comments and
pull requests are its operator's responsibility.

Report problems to the maintainers privately (see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)
for the private reporting route). Maintainers will respond, keep reports
confidential, and may remove content or block accounts that break this code.
